EmailTemplate.name: MEng - Engineering Management
EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your interest in a graduate degree at ASU!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.Name},
Thank you for your interest in the online graduate programs offered through the Ira A. Fulton Schools of Engineering at Arizona State University. We received your inquiry about our graduate engineering offerings, specifically the Master of Engineering.
The Master of Engineering with an area of study in Engineering Management provides an interdisciplinary blend of engineering and business, allowing students to remain technically astute while adding the management component. With this engineering focus, the Master of Engineering with an area of study in Engineering Management is different from an MBA. For more information about this program, please visit https://asuengineeringonline.com/online-degrees/master-engineering-engineering-management-meng NEED NEW LINK HERE
Our programs are intended to be online programs aimed at working professionals who require the convenience and flexibility provided by our online offerings. We do not have a requirement for students to attend campus; you can go through the whole program without ever setting foot in Tempe, Arizona. Of course, we encourage all of our students to join us for graduation to celebrate your accomplishment but even then it is not required.
Many of our working professional students take one to two courses per semester, on average. Students can complete the program as quickly as two years, on average approximately three years, but must be completed within six years. In order to stay active in the program, and abide by the Graduate College guidelines, students must be enrolled each fall and spring semester. We offer courses each fall, spring and summer semesters. Fall and spring are the traditional semester length (15 weeks) while summer sessions are more condensed (6 or 8 weeks).
Students admitted to one of our online programs are assessed online tuition. The program requires 10 courses and we encourage students to budget around $30,000 USD for tuition and fees. You can get the most up-to-date tuition information including a breakdown on the cost per course on this useful page on our site.
We are currently accepting applications for the upcoming semester. You can review the admission application process and begin your application here.
Sincerely,
Angela Harguess Global Outreach & Extended Education Ira A. Fulton Schools of Engineering p: 480-965-1878 | f: 480-965-2929 | ASUEngineeringOnline.com
